description: Payments from ONE Ukrainian public payer to ONE recipient (both by EDRPOU) in a window of up to 92 days, from State Treasury data on spending.gov.ua (keyless). Returns found true/false, payment count, total UAH, a per-month breakdown, and the payment rows with purpose text and any recorded contract number. found:false means the Treasury published no payment between the two in that window — not proof none was made (some payers, e.g. defence, are withheld). Use to check whether and how much a specific public body paid a specific supplier.

date_from.description: Window start, YYYY-MM-DD. Default: 30 days before date_to.

date_to.description: Window end, YYYY-MM-DD. Default: today. Window may not exceed 92 days.

limit.description: Rows to return, newest first (1-500). Default 100.

name: ua_spend_between
title: Ua Spend Between
